column3: CSP: style-src unsafe-inline (deliberate: style-src-elem allows inline style elements because xterm.js offers no nonce, inline style attributes stay refused; SecurityHeaders.java, CSS cannot run script)
Storable and (Non-)Cacheable Content (the hashed static assets are meant to be cached; API answers carry no-cache)
Base64 Disclosure (false positive: a WebGL identifier inside the bundled JavaScript)
Timestamp Disclosure - Unix (false positive: an integer constant inside the bundled JavaScript)
Modern Web Application (informational: the UI is a single-page application)

Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing (deliberate: require-corp would bind the PDF viewer frame and the sandboxed deliverables, and nothing needs cross-origin isolation; COOP and CORP are set, SecurityHeaders.java)
Unexpected Content-Type (false positive: ZAP's probe paths outside /api, such as WS_FTP.INI, get the single-page application's HTML, as designed; no /api route answered HTML in the 2026-11-09 scan)
Client error response code (the API scan sends placeholder values, so 4xx answers are the expected result)
Sec-Fetch-* header missing (a request header the browser sends and ZAP's client does not: a scanner artifact)
